verdict.rationale: Persona documents official Mobile SDKs (native iOS, Android and React Native libraries) and calls integrating one of them the most comprehensive integration path, so the product itself ships SDKs. The evidence covers only client-side mobile SDKs for embedding the verification UI. Missing for 10: documented server-side or backend language SDKs (e.g. Node/Python) for the REST API, SDK reference docs and versioning detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Mobile SDKs | Native iOS, Android, and React Native libraries | Mobile apps, optimal device signals
The most comprehensive way to integrate Persona is to setup an Embedded Flow for web or integrate with one of our Mobile SDKs
